description: This file is a JavaScript module for a TodoMVC application using Knockout.js. It configures Require.js paths, loads modules including Knockout, global configuration, the Todo view model, and additional handlers, then initializes the Todo application by binding a view model to the page after retrieving todos from local storage.

methods.name: require.config
methods.description: Configures AMD loader paths for dependencies.

methods.name: require
methods.description: Loads modules asynchronously and executes callback after loading.

methods.name: ko.utils.parseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON string into JavaScript object.

methods.name: window.localStorage.getItem
methods.description: Retrieves item from local storage with specified key.

methods.name: ko.applyBindings
methods.description: Binds the specified view model to the DOM.
